about: Woodstock is the county seat of Oxford County in southwestern Ontario, on the Thames River between London and Kitchener. It is a manufacturing and service city with a courthouse square, a reservoir conservation area, and a large Toyota assembly plant on the edge of town. Highway 401 runs along the south side. About 47,000 people live in Woodstock.
